title: First arrangements for Mildred Bailey
summary: Mildred and Red like his early writing and ask for more, which starts his career as a writer.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I began, at that time, as (Cyrinus) Tootie did, for Barnet and I guess Mildred and Red sort of liked it and Mildred asked me to do something for her and that's how they kicked the whole thing off on me, because I never really thought of being a professional writer. I hadn't thought of being a professional anything at that point.
I was making money to go back to college. Meanwhile, I didn't know what for either. I liked to play and it had been my complete life, as you can tell, from the beginning.
I needed instruction and I was well aware of that. I wanted something more than I was getting from sheer experience. It wasn't enough and it's never been. Don't let me wander.
It's okay, it all fits in.
